privacy.title: Privacy and Rules
privacy.meta: How {site} handles accounts, public content including images, email recovery, reports, limits, and content moderation.
privacy.intro: {site} is an open and free public social platform designed not to require a real-world identity. This overview explains what is public, what the app stores, how password recovery works, and how reported content is handled.
privacy.public_open: {site} is intended for free public posting. Posts, comments, profiles, likes, follows, and tags are public parts of the platform.
privacy.public_content: Content may be visible to other users and visitors without signing in, and may be available through search, profiles, or tags.
privacy.public_images: You are responsible for the content of every image you upload to the platform. Upload only images you have the necessary rights to publish and that may be publicly accessible.
privacy.public_no_private: The platform has no private messages, private profiles, or personal storage mode. {site} is therefore not meant for sharing private or sensitive things.
privacy.public_no_personal: Do not post personal data, intimate content, non-public documents, or anything you do not want to be publicly accessible.
privacy.feed_no_algorithm: {site} does not use a personalization or recommendation algorithm intended to keep users on the platform longer. We do not collect or evaluate data about your interests to recommend content.
privacy.feed_following: The only way to tailor your own feed is to follow profiles whose posts you want to see. The following feed then displays posts from those profiles.
privacy.feed_no_shadow_bans: We do not use shadow bans or hidden reach restrictions. If moderation takes action against content, it uses a visible action under the platform rules.
privacy.data_account: Registration does not require contact information or a real name. Email is optional and unique when provided. The primary identifier is the username.
privacy.data_email: A provided email can also be used to sign in, recover the password, and receive optional email notifications. Users can control notifications in their profile, while administrators control which notification types are available.
privacy.data_content: The app stores content users create themselves: posts, comments, uploaded images, likes, follows, reports, and optional profile fields.
privacy.data_technical: Passwords are stored only as hashes. Password reset links are short-lived, single-use tokens.
privacy.data_server_logs: {site} stores IP addresses for rate limiting selected signed-in actions such as posts, comments, likes, reports, and searches. The server operator may also have technical server logs outside the app.
privacy.recovery_email: Password recovery uses the /recovery page and a link sent to the account email.
privacy.recovery_no_contact: An email address is optional at registration, but required for email-based password recovery.
privacy.recovery_lost: If no email was added to an account, email recovery is not available.
privacy.recovery_rotation: Reset links expire after 60 minutes and can be used only once.
privacy.reporting_how: A post can be reported through the report icon on the post. The user selects a reason and may add a note.
privacy.reporting_duplicate: The same user cannot keep reopening the same report. If a post was already reviewed as acceptable, another identical report does not reopen it.
privacy.reporting_notification: A user who reported a post gets a notification when the report is resolved or dismissed.
privacy.moderation_right: Because this is a fully public platform, we reserve the right to moderate content, including images, limit its visibility, or remove it, particularly for service safety, platform rules, and applicable law.
privacy.moderation_actions: A moderator can keep a post and lock it against edits, hide it, or remove it.
privacy.moderation_mute: If a post is confirmed as harmful, its author may receive a temporary mute, typically for 24 hours.
privacy.limits_intro: Limits protect the platform from spam and heavy automated use. Signed-in action limits are based on the IP address, so they cannot be bypassed by creating more accounts.
privacy.cookies_session: The app uses necessary technical cookies for sessions and CSRF protection.
privacy.cookies_captcha: When the security captcha is enabled, necessary technical mechanisms are used for verification.
privacy.cookies_remember: Optional remember-me login uses a technical cookie only when the user enables it.
privacy.cookies_analytics: Google Analytics is enabled on this website. Analytics cookies are stored only after consent; when declined, analytics is not loaded.
privacy.cookies_no_analytics: {site} does not use analytics or advertising cookies on this website.
privacy.cookie_consent_text: We use necessary cookies. You can allow analytics.
privacy.cookie_consent_text_captcha: We use necessary cookies. You can allow analytics.
